The PSI of Sampangiramanagar Police Station submitted charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable under sections 406, 420, 468, 120B read with section 34 of IPC.
2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-
The case of the prosecution is that the accused No.1 through his franchisee to accused No.2 had given a loan of Rs.5,00,000/- from the CW-1 company on vehicle bearing No.KA-01-D-6192 for the period of 24 months by agreeing to pay along with interest in total of Rs.6,61,596/-.
The accused No.3 surety to the accused No.2 for the said loan.
But the accused No.2 was paid only Rs.50,000/-.
When the CW-1 demanded to pay the installment to the accused No.2, the accused No.2 informed that the RC was changed and he will not pay any installments.

Thereafter, the CW-1 doubtful against the accused No.2 inquired the Nelamangala RTO office at that time he knows that the RC was changed by forging the CW-1 company seal and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and C.C.No.155/2021 committed the above offences.

After completion of the investigation the PSI of Sampangiramanagar Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable under sections 406, 420, 468, 120B read with section 34 of IPC.

11. In support of its case, the prosecution has examined one witness, the PW-1 is the complainant and got marked the complaint as Ex.P-1.
12.

The case of the prosecution is that the accused No.1 through his franchisee to accused No.2 had given a loan of Rs.5,00,000/- from the CW-1 company on vehicle bearing No.KA-01-D-6192 for the period of 24 months by agreeing to pay along with interest in total of Rs.6,61,596/-.
The accused No.3 surety to the accused No.2 for the said loan.
But the accused No.2 was paid only Rs.50,000/-.
When the CW-1 demanded to pay the installment to the accused No.2, the accused No.2 informed that the RC was changed and he will not pay any installments.

Thereafter, the CW-1 doubtful against the accused No.2 inquired the Nelamangala RTO office at that time he knows that the RC was changed by forging the CW-1 C.C.No.155/2021 company seal and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.

After completion of the investigation the PSI of Sampangiramanagar Police Station has filed the charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable under sections 406,
420, 468, 120B read with section 34 of IPC.
13.
In the instant case the PW-1 has turned hostile to the prosecution case and not supported to the prosecution case.
During the course of cross examination by the learned Sr. APP nothing has been elicited from his mouth.

14. In this case, the prosecution has failed to elicit anything favorable to it to prove the allegations against the accused No.2 and 3 under sections 406, 420, 468 and 120B read with section 34 of IPC.
When these being the facts, I am of the opinion that in total the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.2 and 3 beyond all reasonable doubt.
In view of the same, this court hold Point Nos.1 to 4 in the Negative.
For the reasons stated and finding given to point Nos.1 to 4, the following is made.

ORDER The accused No.2 and 3 are not found guilty for the offences punishable under section 406,
420, 468 and 120B read with section 34 of IPC.
Acting under section 248(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure the accused No.2 and 3 are hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under section 406, 420, 468 and 120B read with section 34 of IPC.
The bail bonds and surety bonds executed by them stand canceled.
